method: 2026-10-31 cross-repository W0X rewrite. One record per row of this spec: action, decisions, retirement reason, new children, rows requested in other specs, cross edits requested of other rows, and harness consumer notes. Rules: one row standard, production caller chain, served proof, both sides declared, knobs, ecosystem boundaries.

cross_edits_requested.change: Mirror the error_redaction finding codes in the sdk-conformance hook so a connector repository sees the same finding before CI.

decisions: Conformance method is the SDK pytest-plugin check (R006.2); the index test only validates owners and modules.
The check is a static scan with three finding codes; a dynamic probe was rejected because no generic way names a connector's upstream URL.
